items.question: Who is Monica Wright?
items.answer: Monica Wright is a former WNBA guard from the University of Virginia. The Minnesota Lynx took her second overall in the 2010 WNBA Draft, and she won WNBA championships with Minnesota in 2011 and 2013.

items.question: How tall is Monica Wright?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Monica Wright at 5 feet 10 inches and 182 pounds.

items.question: What was Monica Wright's best WNBA season?
items.answer: Monica Wright played 7 WNBA regular seasons, from 2010 to 2016, for the Minnesota Lynx and Seattle Storm. Her best season was her 2010 rookie year, when she averaged 11.1 points in 34 games and made the All-Rookie Team.

items.question: Where did Monica Wright play in college?
items.answer: Monica Wright played at Virginia, where she was a three-time AP All-American, the 2010 ACC Player of the Year and the school's all-time leading scorer with 2,540 points.
